context.title: The Sacramento Bee Editorial Board — November 3, 2026 California general election endorsements

subject.title: Governor of California

positions.statement: "Democrat Xavier Becerra does not receive our endorsement by default, but because he shows the potential to lead this state well into an uncertain future, and offers a steadier, more substantive style of leadership that California has long — and desperately — needed."

subject.title: California Controller

positions.statement: "The collective editorial boards of The Sacramento Bee, Modesto Bee, Merced Sun-Star, Fresno Bee and San Luis Obispo Tribune endorse Morgan because he is the most qualified person for the office."

subject.title: US House of Representatives, California District 3

positions.statement: "That’s why California voters approved Prop. 50 and it’s why Bera is the only candidate in this race who can be counted on to deliver."

subject.title: California State Assembly, District 1

positions.statement: "We endorse Hadwick for another term representing California’s 1st Assembly District."

subject.title: California State Assembly, District 6

positions.statement: "The Sacramento Bee Editorial Board endorses Krell in her re-election campaign to continue representing the Assembly’s 6th District."

subject.title: California — Proposition 3 (Provides Permanent Funding for Schools and Health Care by Extending Existing Tax on High Incomes)

positions.statement: "McClatchy’s California editorial board, representing The Sacramento Bee, Modesto Bee, Merced Sun-Star, Fresno Bee and San Luis Obispo Tribune, recommends a “Yes” vote on Prop. 3."

subject.title: California — Proposition 4 (Repeals Prohibition Against Public Funding of Election Campaigns)

positions.statement: "The editorial boards of The Sacramento Bee, Modesto Bee, Merced Sun-Star, Fresno Bee and San Luis Obispo Tribune recommend a “Yes” vote on Prop. 4."

subject.title: California — Proposition 5 (Changes Recall Election Process for Statewide Officers)

positions.statement: "McClatchy Media’s California editorial board strongly urges a “yes” vote on Proposition 5."

subject.title: California — Proposition 37 (Creates Loan Program for Middle-Income Buyers of Qualified New Homes)

positions.statement: "McClatchy’s California editorial board, representing The Sacramento Bee, Modesto Bee, Merced Sun-Star, Fresno Bee and San Luis Obispo Tribune, recommends a “Yes” vote on Prop. 37."

subject.title: California — Proposition 40 (Imposes One-Time Tax on Certain Taxpayers)

positions.statement: "Though it was not unanimous, a majority of our editorial board endorses Prop. 40 ... Vote yes on Proposition 40."

subject.title: California — Proposition 42 (Prohibits New State Personal Property Taxes and Certain Retroactive State Taxes)

positions.statement: "Prop. 42 is a poison pill designed to derail the real debate over a one-time wealth tax on billionaires. Voters should reject the decoy and vote no."

subject.title: California — Proposition 43 (Limits Voters' Ability to Raise Revenues for Local Government Services)

positions.statement: "This is why the combined editorial boards of The Sacramento Bee, Modesto Bee, Merced Sun-Star, Fresno Bee and San Luis Obispo Tribune oppose Prop. 43. We strongly urge a “no” vote."

subject.title: California — Proposition 44 (Requires Community Health Clinics Spend 90% Of Revenue on Program Services)

positions.statement: "McClatchy’s California editorial board, representing The Sacramento Bee, Modesto Bee, Merced Sun-Star, Fresno Bee and San Luis Obispo Tribune, recommends a “No” vote on Prop. 44."

subject.title: California — Proposition 45 (Modifies Environmental Review for Certain Projects)

positions.statement: "McClatchy’s California editorial board, representing The Sacramento Bee, Modesto Bee, Merced Sun-Star, Fresno Bee and San Luis Obispo Tribune, recommends a “Yes” vote on Prop. 45."
